subject: FirstShore: consolidated restore playbook summaries & recent test records
messages:
From: Claire Summers <claire.summers@firstshore.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@firstshore.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:44:12 -0800
Subject: Request: consolidated restore playbooks + test records (SOC2/SIG review)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the SOC2 walk-through last week. As part of FirstShore's vendor verification for both SOC2 and the SIG intake, our security team needs a compact package showing how Redwood performs full restores and the recent test evidence. Specifically we need: 

- A single-page summary of your restore playbooks and decision flow during a primary-region outage (high level, not full runbook).
- One-line RTO/RPO commitment per service (in minutes/hours) and the observable provenance (logs/traces) that support that claim.
- Artifacts from your last three restore exercises (date, scope, outcome, who ran it).
- Cache-warm traces and timings for KV caches used in inference serving (we're trying to validate warm-cache recovery behavior).
- Any previous post-mortem or test logs that show a timed restore sequence (no redaction required except for internal IPs).

Could you send a consolidated bundle by EOD next Tuesday so we can close the SIG questionnaire? If some items are sensitive, tell us what can be shared and provide redaction guidance.

Appreciate it,
Claire

Claire Summers
Security Program Manager | FirstShore Bank
claire.summers@firstshore.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Summers <claire.summers@firstshore.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:04 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated restore playbooks + test records (SOC2/SIG review)

Claire,

Thanks for the clear list — we can do that. High-level plan: I'll assemble the single-page playbook summary and a timeline of our last three full-recover tests, and Karthik will extract the KV warm-cache timing traces. Marcus will pull the signed test reports and the RTO/RPO matrix.

One quick clarification: when you say "per service" — do you want it per API route/model (e.g., embeddings, chat-gen) or per infrastructure component (control plane, serving, state store)? We can provide both, but that'll change the bundle size.

I aim to have a redacted bundle and a short-read summary by Tue EOD (2026-12-07). If you need the raw logs earlier, we can provide a secure link.

Best,
Ben

Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Customer Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: FirstShore: consolidated restore playbook summaries & recent test records

Ben / Marcus,

I'll pull the KV cache warm traces for the last three full restores: 2026-10-21 (tabletop), 2026-07-14 (partial DR exercise), 2026-04-02 (full run). I have CSV exports from our trace store; they include per-request warm/hit rates and average token latency within the first 60s of restore. I'll also generate a short appendix that maps the observed warm-cache curve to the effective RTO we measure for chat-gen vs. embeddings. Expect the CSVs + a short readme.

Karthik

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 13:21:44 -0800
Subject: Re: FirstShore: consolidated restore playbook summaries & recent test records

Folks,

I've pulled the signed test reports and consolidated the RTO/RPO matrix. Key notes for Claire:

- Control plane: RTO 15m / RPO 0 (config snap-based restore + leader election). Test: 2026-10-21, outcome: successful failover in 13m 47s. (attached: tabletop-test-20261021.log)
- Serving (chat-gen models): RTO observed 4-8m for baseline (dependent on KV warm). RPO: ~30s (replicated state+append-only logs). Test: 2026-07-14, partial DR — warm-cache step reduced steady-state error rate by 78% after 6m.
- Embeddings service: RTO 6-10m, RPO <1m. Test: 2026-04-02 full run.

I've added a short recovery-run timeline for the 2026-10-21 drill: snapshot restore -> DB restore -> registry sync -> serving rollout -> KV-warm (see attached).

Attachments included: FS_restore_playbook_summary.pdf, tabletop-test-20261021.log, kv-warm-cache-timings-20261021.csv

Marcus

From: Claire Summers <claire.summers@firstshore.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@firstshore.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 08:18:33 -0800
Subject: Re: FirstShore: consolidated restore playbook summaries & recent test records

Ben — this is perfect and much appreciated. Two follow-ups from the security team after a quick skim: 

1) For the KV warm traces CSV can you add a short column that shows the cumulative % of traffic served from cache at the 1, 2, 5, and 10 minute marks? That helps us map to customer-impact windows.

2) We need a short statement from Redwood attesting that the artifacts are representative of normal production restores (not synthetic) and whether any of the tests included injected faults that do not mirror normal outage modes. A one-paragraph attestation is fine.

If you can add those two items, we should be able to close out the SIG and move to contracting.

Thanks,
Claire
